instruction.text: Read and listen to the short story.

atoms.text: Ben lives at home with his grandma and grandpa. They have a huge farm with lots of animals. They have cows, horses, pigs, cats, dogs and even a turtle!
atoms.sound: ssml: At the farm <break time='1000ms'/> Ben lives at home with his grandma and grandpa. They have a huge farm with lots of animals. They have cows, horses, pigs, cats, dogs and even a turtle!

atoms.text: Ben wakes up every morning to help feed the animals. First, he goes to the barn. The cows, horses and pigs are always happy to see him!

atoms.a: What is the main idea of the story so far?
b: ++Ben lives on a farm with his grandparents.
Ben eats breakfast with his grandparents.

atoms.text: Ben opens the barn door and says, “Good morning! I think today will be a good day.” Then he smiles and gives all the animals a pat.
atoms.sound: ssml: Ben opens the barn door and says<voice voice='m3_2025'> good morning! I think today will be a good day! </voice> Then he smiles and gives all the animals a pat.

atoms.text:
Next, Ben goes back inside. The cats and dogs live with Ben’s family. He feeds them in the kitchen. They dance and wiggle while they wait for food. “Woof! Woof!” say the dogs.
Ben answers, “Woof back!”
atoms.sound: ssml: Next, Ben goes back inside. The cats and dogs live with Ben’s family. He feeds them in the kitchen. They dance and wiggle while they wait for food. <voice voice='f3_2025'>woof! woof!</voice> say the dogs. Ben answers<voice voice='m3_2025'> woof back! </voice>

atoms.text: Then Ben has to go to his room to feed his turtle. He tells the turtle, “I always feed you last. But you never complain!”
atoms.sound: ssml: Then Ben has to go to his room to feed his turtle. He tells the turtle,<voice voice='m3_2025'> I always feed you last. But you never complain! </voice>

atoms.a: What is the main idea of the story now?

atoms.text:
Ben finally sits down with his grandparents. His grandma asks, “Did you feed the pigs?”
Ben says, “And the horses, cows, cats, dogs and my turtle!”
atoms.sound: ssml: Ben finally sits down with his grandparents. His grandma asks,<voice voice='f1'> Did you feed the pigs? </voice>Ben says,<voice voice='m3_2025'> and the horses, cows, cats, dogs and my turtle!</voice>

atoms.text: Ben’s grandpa says, “We don’t know what we would do without you!”
atoms.sound: ssml: Ben’s grandpa says<voice voice='m1'> we don’t know what we would do without you! </voice>

atoms.a: What is the main idea of the story?
b: Ben is too busy to help.
